text:
rachel: heads-up — ran into a weird ordering/merge bug in the retriever sampleapp. embeddings + rerank + auth refresh. sometimes final merged embeddings are out-of-order or one item missing after a 401->retry.

ben: ouch, can you paste the tiny repro and the observed vs expected?

rachel: repro: 7 docs, batchingHelper batch_size=3, force token rotation during the second sub-batch. node client call looks like: `await client.embeddings({ input: texts })` inside `batchingHelper.enqueue`. expected: 7 embeddings in original doc order. observed: 6 embeddings or 7 but order shuffled (doc id 3 present twice, doc id 5 missing). logs: 
```
[2026-03-23T12:00:01Z] batching: send subbatch id=0 ids=[0,1,2]
[2026-03-23T12:00:01Z] batching: send subbatch id=1 ids=[3,4,5]
[2026-03-23T12:00:02Z] auth: refresh triggered -> 401 on subbatch id=1
[2026-03-23T12:00:02Z] embeddings: retry subbatch id=1 snapshot=[] // empty because helper mutated queue
[2026-03-23T12:00:03Z] embeddings: response len=2 for retry (expected 3)
[2026-03-23T12:00:03Z] final: merged=6 expected=7
```

omar: that log line `snapshot=[]` is telling — the retry path is reconstructing from the live queue which got mutated by the enqueuing of doc 6. two fixes: (A) snapshot [{id, payload}] for each sub-batch before sending so retries use the exact items, (B) merge results by id not by array position.

rachel: tried (A) locally — deep-copying the sub-batch before network send fixed the missing/duplicate symptoms in my runs. PR: https://github.com/redwoodinc/sampleapp/pull/1402 (WIP).

ben: also add a tiny shim in SDKs to accept both `[{...}, ...]` and `{ "embeddings": [...] }` shapes and normalize to `{ "embeddings": [...], "model": "alias@v" }` so sampleapps see consistent output while we standardize.

omar: agree. long-term we should require merging by stable ids and add an SDK parity test that simulates token rotation + varied routing (so we catch dim flips or shape diffs). add a model-catalog note: retries should ideally hit same variant or the server must preserve contract.

rachel: will add a mocha/regression test that injects a fake 401 mid-batch and asserts merged length==input length and ordering by id. will also add a short onboarding note in devex guide about batching+auth gotchas.

sdk-bot: canary build queued for branch rachel/batch-snapshot (build 4732).

ben: thanks — assign owner and put a bullet in the next release notes under "SDK parity & embeddings": snapshot sub-batches, normalize response shape, merge by ids, add e2e for token rotation.

rachel: owner assigned to me. will follow up with PRs for node helper + sampleapp test and a python shim. thanks :pray:
